groups.label: Front door
groups.caption: HTTP, MCP & the browser
groups.description: API accepts requests, Tools controls the callable catalog, and UI hosts the browser. Small adapters connect these registries to the domain plugins.

groups.label: Identity
groups.caption: Shared user login
groups.description: Identity verifies shared users. Scope owns project membership, permissions and tool policy. External Mounts owns upstream credential selection.

groups.label: Integrations
groups.caption: Remote tools, compute & search
groups.description: External Mounts connects independent MCP servers to the local tool registry. Sandboxes connects directly to the remote compute service over HTTP, publishing its views and lease controls. Web searches the internet through Tavily, with OpenAI's hosted web search as its fallback, and Nisa searches the literature through RapidReview's paper index. Each integration owns its upstream credentials; availability is not proof of remote health.

groups.label: Research
groups.caption: The work & what we learn
groups.description: Research workflows own scientific work, its context recipes and paper edit proposals. Paper stores the reviewed documents; Knowledge assembles source records. Research keeps its State/Scope/Workflows core active and binds Paper, Reflections, Knowledge and Consolidation optionally. Only stages that use a missing provider wait. Selected code changes use Consolidation, which requires Code.

groups.label: Coordination
groups.caption: Gates, agents & code
groups.description: Workflows evaluates gates and assignments. Agent Sessions controls worker authority and recovery. Code retains requests and exact code-capture references. The separate Runner performs machine work.

groups.label: Evidence
groups.caption: Files, reviews & context
groups.description: Artifacts owns file metadata. Reviews retains independent assessments. Context Builder assembles the domain's context recipe. Feed records project activity.

groups.label: External services
groups.caption: Connected over MCP / HTTP
groups.description: Nisa and the Sandboxes compute service run independently. Optional MCP mounts expose remote tools; the local Sandboxes plugin also connects to the compute service over HTTP.

groups.label: Foundation
groups.caption: Shared durable capabilities
groups.description: State and Scope are the most shared dependencies. Blobs stores bytes without depending on State; Artifacts connects file metadata to those bytes. Domain Events reads durable events from State.

groups.label: Separate machine
groups.caption: Agents & Git checkouts
groups.description: Runner has its own Cordis context. It talks to the server over authenticated HTTP and launches scoped agents in scratch or Git workspaces. It has no injected server-plugin dependencies.

api.label: API
api.purpose: Accepts authenticated HTTP and MCP requests and routes them through the tool registry.

tools.label: Tools
tools.purpose: Registers native and mounted tools, applies grants and worker constraints, and drains admitted calls during unload.

ui.label: UI
ui.purpose: Serves the browser and the registry of plugin-owned views. Removing a UI adapter removes that view.

identity.label: Identity
identity.purpose: Verifies the shared user's identity. Project membership and roles remain in Scope.

mounts.label: External Mounts
mounts.purpose: Connects remote MCP tools to Tools with names such as _nisa.search. Owns upstream credential bindings and secret resolution; Scope supplies caller tool policy.

sandboxes.label: Sandboxes
sandboxes.purpose: Connects to the remote compute service over HTTP, reads its published views and scoped records, and extends or releases sandbox leases. Its tool adapter enforces project write permission; its UI adapter publishes the service's views. The provider owns upstream credentials and has no injected Cordis dependencies.

nisa.label: Nisa
nisa.purpose: Searches the scholarly literature for every agent through Nisa's public API: keyword and semantic search, one paper's record, passages inside its full text, and similar papers, each named the way paper.cite takes it. Its tools are open-world reads with one deployment-wide key. Composed only where that key is configured; it has no injected Cordis dependencies.

web.label: Web
web.purpose: Searches the internet and reads pages for every agent, as Nisa's agents do: Tavily first, OpenAI's hosted web search when Tavily refuses its key. Pages are read only through Tavily, never from Merv's network. Its tools are open-world reads, and it counts each project's calls per day in memory. Composed only where a key is configured; it has no injected Cordis dependencies.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.purpose: Owns task briefs, acceptance checks, evidence submissions, closure rules and task-specific context formulas.

experiments.label: Experiments
experiments.purpose: Owns plans, attempts, approved evidence, results, exhibits and both independent review stages. Git experiments bind review to the exact producer capture.

knowledge.label: Knowledge
knowledge.purpose: Reads live project research records and resolves research-linked evidence for reflection agents. Historical corpus capture remains available to existing callers.

workflows.label: Workflows
workflows.purpose: Owns the common state graph, revisions, prerequisites, current gate, blockers, next actions, assignments and lease hooks. Domains provide their own rules.

sessions.label: Agent Sessions
sessions.purpose: Owns continuing agent identity, context-reset history and authenticated sessions. Attaches one workflow assignment at a time, freezes its context and tool permissions, and fences each execution independently. Runner launches fresh agents; external agents can explicitly change assignments.

code.label: Code
code.purpose: Retains code-commit requests, exact command and final-session capture references, and immutable proposal manifests. Also owns optional project GitHub connections and repository selection through its existing API/UI adapters. Runner executes Git; GitHub adds no Cordis dependency.

artifacts.label: Artifacts
artifacts.purpose: Owns immutable file metadata, content hashes and permission-checked reads. It stores records in State and bytes through Blobs.

reviews.label: Reviews
reviews.purpose: Pins evidence, enforces independent review, retains findings and verdicts, and invokes the owning domain's transition in the same transaction.

contextBuilder.label: Context Builder
contextBuilder.purpose: Assembles and persists starting context from the domain's versioned recipe and exact input references. It does not own task or experiment rules.

feed.label: Feed
feed.purpose: Records project posts, replies and activity with optional artifact references.

state.label: State
state.purpose: Provides async transactions, migrations, durable records and the event ledger. Configuration selects SQLite or PostgreSQL behind the same contract.

scope.label: Scope
scope.purpose: Owns projects, security actors, memberships, credentials and permissions, plus the project Introduction. Agent Sessions owns agent identity and lifetime; Scope enforces its security actor and delegated authority. Scope also owns exact remote-tool grants and the registered session policy.

blobs.label: Blobs
blobs.purpose: Stores and reads file bytes by content hash. It has no State dependency; Artifacts owns the associated file metadata.

domainEvents.label: Domain Events
domainEvents.purpose: Delivers durable events from State so consumers can react and recover without losing their place.

runner.label: Runner
runner.purpose: Runs on a separate machine, launches agents, maintains their leases and captures Git workspaces. It calls server controls over HTTP.

paper.label: Paper
paper.purpose: Stores the living research narrative, citations and revision history. Main agents edit all sections; experiment and reflection reviewers author Methods/Results updates with their verdicts. Experiment references display names and link to the underlying records; earlier proposals remain historical.

reflections.label: Reflections
reflections.purpose: Owns five independent lenses, synthesis and review. Workflows pauses new task and experiment starts until approval. No Knowledge dependency; reflection assignments, leases and submissions survive Knowledge removal, while extra research-evidence reads wait for its return. Its own Paper dependency remains required.

consolidation.label: Consolidation
consolidation.purpose: Implements and reviews code changes from pinned source artifacts and a selected experiment scope. Requires Code and does not depend on Reflections. Historical report-only cycles remain supported.

research.label: Research
research.purpose: Coordinates the outer cycle with only State, Scope and Workflows required. Optional Paper supplies the problem definition; Reflections starts waves and verifies approval; Knowledge supplies live-evidence permissions and unsnapshotted consolidation inputs; Consolidation handles selected code changes. Research stays active when any optional provider is removed, and only operations that use it wait with a named blocker. Stored records and completed command receipts remain readable; absence never means empty or approved evidence. New cycles can finish after approved reflection without consolidation. Paper changes belong to scientific workflows.
